title: One trip for the whole group
description: Agree on the options, build a shared plan and split the expenses among the participants in a way everyone can follow.

blocks.text: In a group, the door code, the arrival times and the expenses drown in the chat. A shared trip should help find a decision already made, not create a second chat.

quote.text: I’m obsessed with this app. No more scrolling through a massive group chat to find an Airbnb door code. Or hunting people down to split expenses. Or texting people asking for their flight number.

blocks.text: Proposals are kept apart from the agreed plan and from tickets already bought. Each expense names who paid and who took part; everyone sees the explanation of their own share and the documents they need.
What decides whether it is useful

One trip with a small group is enough to start. What is worth testing is a new participant joining and an expense being corrected. If the organizer still has to explain every change separately, the shared display hasn’t solved the job.
